title: CloudTrail: the audit log, and answering "who did this?"

videos.script: Sooner or later every incident asks the same question. Who did this? {{who}} In AWS, every request to an API is an event, and CloudTrail writes it down: who asked, from where, for what, and what the answer was. {{event}} You will create a trail that covers every region and signs its files, and see why ninety days of event history is not an audit log. {{trail}} You will read one record field by field, and learn why a role's session name is the difference between who and somebody. {{record}} Then a made-up day of the shop. A bucket is gone and a rule has disappeared. Four questions, one command each, and the answer is a conversation, not a hunt. {{day}} Last, the trail as an alarm. The key from lesson eighteen, used while it waits to be deleted. And a rule that pages the moment somebody schedules a deletion. {{alarm}}
